measured_model.scope_warning: Numerical J-Space measurements are exact-model/snapshot evidence only and do not automatically transfer to another Qwen3.5-0.8B checkpoint.

observations.semantic_readability: 0.94-1.00 from approximately L6 onward on the measured lexically separated family

source_evidence.strongest_supported_training_interpretat: Semantic reading, symbol-axis writeout and carrier-space binding algebra are already present at measured scope. The missing behavior is context-dependent episodic routing that maps decoded semantics through the current episode-local codebook to the correct emitted symbol, with cross-template invariance.

protect_not_primary_relearning_targets: HRR/MAP carrier algebra through measured k<=16
training_delta.hypothesis: A relatively narrow learned semantic-to-episode-codebook routing computation can raise held-out codebook accuracy without relearning semantics or symbol emission.
counterhypotheses: The apparent gap is not a missing router but a prompt/template-specific decoding artifact.
The task requires broad model adaptation rather than a narrow binding circuit.
High training accuracy can be achieved by lexical, position, permutation-id or symbol-frequency shortcuts without true episode-local binding.
The measured J-Space read/write sites are checkpoint-specific and may not remain useful after checkpoint selection or training.

review_findings.reason: The measured evidence directly supports a binding/routing gap more strongly than a missing semantic reader, missing symbol writer or insufficient carrier algebra.
The inherited generator can log a permutation without using it causally, can pass a nonfunctional class-word leak check, and underchecks lexical/template isolation.

Each structural template must contain the complete 6-permutation S3 family crossed with all 3 target semantic classes, yielding 18 balanced core episodes per template. This makes each semantic class map to each of three symbol slots exactly twice per template before lexical replication.

The repository evidence establishes 46 accepted single-token atoms and one rejected atom but does not expose the complete literal atom list in the canonical research artifact. Generator blueprints therefore use ABI atom-row references and are not trainable until exact manifest/row/tokenizer identity is verified.
Training must not receive success credit by damaging semantic readability, symbol writeout, general language/code competence, typed protocol behavior or authority boundaries.

Output accuracy alone cannot prove a J-Space binder. After a binding mechanism is learned, lesion/shuffle must selectively destroy codebook routing while preserving semantic readability, and rescue must restore it.
The future Xeno harness must expose an exact trace chain from semantic decision to episode codebook lookup to emitted atom while preserving deterministic S0/S1/effect boundaries.
The design is useful training research but mints zero accepted dataset tokens and zero training/runtime credit until generator, manifest, split and executable evidence gates pass.

generator_blueprint.class_label_policy: Preregister one interpretation before materialization: class labels may appear only inside the episode-local codebook span; the target semantic class must not appear elsewhere in prompt or answer metadata visible to the model. A separately versioned label-free demonstration-codebook successor is also admissible, but the two policies must not be mixed silently.
generator_blueprint.symbol_source: Resolve literal symbols only from the exact verified 46-row accepted XENO_VECTOR_ABI atom manifest for the exact tokenizer/model identity; exclude rejected atom 'or'.
generator_blueprint.core_cartesian_rule: For each structural template, emit every S3 mapping crossed with every target semantic class: 6 permutations x 3 classes = 18 core episodes.
generator_blueprint.validation_policy: Generate validation/calibration from separate semantic-bearing lexical families and separate provenance ancestry while reusing only nonsemantic protocol structure. The frozen T_BIND_RELATIONAL_HOLDOUT family is absent from train and validation.
generator_blueprint.counterfactual_pair_rule: For a fixed semantic situation, create matched episodes that differ only in the episode-local class-to-symbol permutation. The correct output must change exactly when the codebook mapping changes. This is the primary anti-static-association pressure.
generator_blueprint.codebook_order_rule: Independently randomize displayed codebook entry order; mapping identity must be derived from the realized class<->symbol pairs, never a metadata permutation id alone.
generator_blueprint.position_rule: Counterbalance example/query position and codebook order so target class, symbol slot and output token are not predictable from position.
generator_blueprint.lexical_rule: Semantic-bearing subjects, predicates, adjectives, negation forms and paraphrase families are split-isolated. Protocol separators and explicitly preregistered codebook syntax may be exempted from literal-token disjointness.
generator_blueprint.target_derivation_rule: target_symbol = realized_codebook[target_semantic_class]; target_symbol is never sampled independently and never derived from a logging-only permutation field.
generator_blueprint.family_split_rule: Keep connected causal-family and provenance-ancestry components within exactly one of TRAIN, VAL or HOLDOUT; holdout rows must have selected_using_holdout=false.

deterministic_generator_repair_gates: PERMUTATION_CAUSALITY: realized class<->symbol mapping must be constructed from the selected S3 permutation and target derived from that realized mapping.
FULL_S3_COVERAGE: require exactly the declared six permutations at the required family scope, not len(perms)>=3.
EXACT_COUNTERBALANCE: each class-symbol-slot pair differs by at most one count at every admitted balanced block; for the 18-row core it is exact two-per-pair.
MUTUAL_INFORMATION_CHECK: class and output symbol frequency must not provide a shortcut outside the episode codebook; report MI and deterministic expected counts.
CLASS_WORD_LEAK_CHECK: class words/synonyms outside the allowed codebook span are a hard failure under the chosen preregistered policy.
LEXICAL_FAMILY_ISOLATION: normalized semantic-bearing lexeme/family overlap across splits is a hard failure except explicit protocol-token exemptions.
TEMPLATE_HOLDOUT_ISOLATION: frozen T_BIND_RELATIONAL_HOLDOUT is absent from train and validation.
ABI_MANIFEST_INTEGRITY: verify archive/manifest/member hashes, atom row mapping, tokenizer single-token property and rejected-atom exclusion before literal materialization.
PROVENANCE_INTEGRITY: bind model/checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/generator version/ABI manifest/source package to every realized row family.
TARGET_RECOMPUTE: validator independently recomputes target from realized codebook and hidden semantic label; metadata target disagreement is failure.
COUNTERFACTUAL_FLIP: matched same-semantics/different-codebook pairs must flip target exactly when mapping changes.
NO_HOLDOUT_SELECTION: split assignment, thresholds, templates, lexical families, codebook policy and atom holdout are frozen before holdout scoring.

acceptance_contract.general_language_and_code_retention: within 2% of frozen baseline unless a newer owner directive explicitly changes the floor
acceptance_contract.semantic_readability_retention: must not materially regress from frozen same-checkpoint baseline
acceptance_contract.symbol_writeout_retention: must remain intact at same-checkpoint post-training evaluation
acceptance_contract.causal_posttrain_test: Lesion/shuffle the learned binder while preserving semantic readability: codebook symbol selection must fail selectively; rescue must restore it. Output accuracy alone does not establish J-Space causality.
acceptance_contract.statistics: Report uncertainty, per-family/worst-case accuracy, shortcut-control performance, retention damage bounds and exact frozen sample identities.

integration_with_xeno_hcu_training.matrix_delta: Add DYNAMIC_EPISODIC_CODEBOOK_ROUTING and CONTEXT_INVARIANT_SEMANTIC_BINDING as explicit model-facing capabilities feeding J-Space/GWT/HCU protocol specialization rather than treating them as generic semantics.
integration_with_xeno_hcu_training.architecture_boundary: This learned binder remains cognition only. It cannot grant S1 coordinator authority, S0 canonical truth, effect authority or capability authority.
integration_with_xeno_hcu_training.role_flexibility_link: The same binding primitive can encode temporary runtime roles/relations without training permanent node personalities, provided deterministic authority remains outside the model.
integration_with_xeno_hcu_training.hyperposition_link: The binder can carry unresolved relation bindings, but Hyperposition collapse still requires evidence; binding a branch identifier is not fact promotion.
